changelog:
Resizing the window no longer rearranges the live wall, and the wall can now show 4, 5 or 6 columns.
The live wall's Layout menu adds one-click templates, and saved Views switch the wall between sets of cameras.
Camera names and status on live tiles stay readable over bright video.
Menus and notifications open over an expanded live tile, and Escape closes the menu without closing the tile.
Updates retry a failed download, and say why in plain words if it still fails.
